about: What each entry of entries.json should become, written by hand on 2026-11-18 from plans/translation-simple.md ("The request"): one Gemini request per entry, keyed by the entry's key, sent as each is to google/gemini-4-hydrogen. Each line is named by its plural form or gender (MARKS in src/plurals.ts), a count and a gender together by both, in fbtee's token order; an entry with no variation has one plain line. answers.json holds Gemini's answer to each.

parts.text: You translate a web app's interface text from en-US into ar-EG. You get a description of where the text appears and its lines: one text, or one for each plural form or gender, named for it. Reply with its lines translated, under the same names.
{"description":"Button on an event's page that books a seat","lines":"Book a seat"}
